name: Juice Caboose
notes: 4 photos: photo 1 is the Amazing Bowls board (base/'Classic' tier price used, not the mega upsize). Photo 4 is a newer, cropped hanging sign showing higher current prices for Gourmet Wraps, Salads & Platters, Hot Sandwiches, Specialty Sandwiches, and the three juice categories (including new items marked '(NEW)': Greek Spinach Salad, Hot Ham Special, Ham Classic Sandwich); those newer prices superseded the older matching items in photo 2 (wraps/sandwiches) and photo 3 (juices), merged rather than duplicated. Photo 4 does not show House Smoothies/Power Smoothies/Shots, so those were kept from photo 3 at its prices. Juices/smoothies are listed by size (S/M/L/XL); the Large price was used by convention for each, except The Green Thing and Detox which print their own override price at Large. Extra Toppings and Nutropeps add-on lists were skipped as modifiers, and the build-your-own Custom Blend was skipped as a modifier menu with no fixed price.
